tools.name: list_picks
tools.description: Staff picks in Boston or Denver, each with a one-line reason. Use this for “what should I see?”, “what’s good”, “anything worth going to?”, “featured”, “date night”, “romantic”, or any public curated list. Always cite `url` (app deep link /e/?id=). Do not rewrite to /event/. Omit collection to list

Default window is tonight (today + next 2 days). Pass window=weekend for Fri–Sun, window=upcoming for today onward. Pa

tools.name: shows_tonight
tools.description: Concerts and comedy tonight and the next two days in Boston (default), Denver (city=denver), San Francisco (city=sanfrancisco), Nashville (city=nashville) or New York (city=newyork), in the city's own time zone. Use this for “what's on tonight?”, “anything going on?”, “live music near me tonight”. D

tools.name: shows_this_weekend
tools.description: Concerts and comedy this Friday through Sunday (the remaining or upcoming weekend) in Boston (default), Denver (city=denver), San Francisco (city=sanfrancisco), Nashville (city=nashville) or New York (city=newyork). Use this for “what's on this weekend?”. Default sort=evening. free=true, event_type=

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: Venues in Boston, Denver, San Francisco, Nashville or New York that have upcoming shows, with show_count and public facts (address, capacity, bag_policy, MBTA in Boston). Paginated: default 20, max 50, always includes total. Use get_venue or search_shows with venue= for one room and its upcoming sho

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: One venue in Boston, Denver, San Francisco, Nashville or New York (id, id_variant, or slug) and a page of its upcoming shows. With no city it looks in every city. Use for “shows at Paradise” when you already have the venue id/slug; otherwise search_shows with venue=. Paginated: default 20, max 50, a

tools.name: get_show
tools.description: One show by its id (from any list here, or the id= in a foobos.net/e/ link), in either city. Use for “tell me more about that one”: the full bill, time, price, ages, sold out, the note on what is special about the night, and the room's facts (address, capacity, bag policy, transit). Always cite `url

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Hand-made foobos guides in Boston, Denver, San Francisco, Nashville or New York: themed lists like “Rare Shows”, “Cool New Shows”, “Top Shows This Weekend”, “On The Green Line” or “Altitude Adjustment”, each with a curator and a short intro. Use when someone wants ideas, a theme, or “what's special”

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One guide's upcoming shows in the curator's order, each with the curator's note as `why` when there is one. With no city it uses the city where the guide has the most shows. Always cite each show's `url`. Paginated: default 20, max 50, always includes total.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "shows_tonight" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
